name: Wyndham Nordelta Tigre
description: The most prestigious and luxurious hotel near Parque de la Costa — the Wyndham Nordelta Tigre is a spectacular 5-star resort hotel in the exclusive Nordelta gated community near Tigre, featuring magnificent rooms, multiple pools, outstanding restaurants and beautiful Delta wetland views. The finest hotel experience for Parque de la Costa visitors.

name: La Posta de Tigre Hotel & Resort
description: A charming and beloved boutique hotel resort in the heart of Tigre, just minutes from Parque de la Costa — La Posta de Tigre is a beautiful riverside resort hotel with outstanding pools, a spa, excellent Argentine dining and authentic Delta atmosphere.

name: Rio Tigre Hotel
description: A comfortable and well-regarded hotel on the banks of the Tigre river, minutes from Parque de la Costa — Rio Tigre Hotel offers pleasant rooms, a pool and easy access to both the park and the Tigre Delta boat trips, making it one of the most conveniently situated hotels for Parque de la Costa visitors.

name: Villa Victoria de Tigre
description: A beautifully restored and atmospheric heritage villa hotel in the historic centre of Tigre — Villa Victoria de Tigre is a charming boutique hotel in a magnificent early 20th century mansion offering elegant rooms, gardens and a uniquely atmospheric Argentine Delta experience for Parque de la Costa visitors.
